notes: Mapped live against game_plugin.dll 27.0.1+2494687 (the offsets come from RTTI class names and object layouts, not from RVAs, so they should survive small patches). Collections are found by RTTI (layout rttiInstances); no roots needed. Person records (Player, Staff) use their db::PERSON part as the base: +0x288 in db::ACTUAL_PLAYER, +0x100 in db::ACTUAL_NON_PLAYER, +0x380 in db::ACTUAL_PLAYER_AND_NON_PLAYER, +0x440 in db::HUMAN_NON_PLAYER. Player-managers (ACTUAL_PLAYER_AND_NON_PLAYER) are listed as Staff only: their db::PLAYING_DATA sits 0x238 before the person part instead of 0x140, so player-only fields would read wrong for them. Names: the person points at a shared name-table entry whose first qword is the string, so editing a first name renames everyone who shares it. Strings are FM length-prefixed UTF-8 (fmString). Dates count the day of year from 1 (dateDayBase 1); 1/1900 is the empty date. Checked against real birth dates (Haaland, Mbappé, Bellingham, Yamal, Guardiola). CA/PA checked across all 32,631 players (1 <= CA <= PA <= 200). Attributes are bytes in db::PLAYING_DATA (person-0x129 to -0xF4), stored as 1-100 and shown rounded /5. Outfield attributes were matched against four Real Madrid players' screens (Courtois, Huijsen, Mbappé, Espí), each to a single byte. Goalkeeping attributes were matched against Courtois and Lunin, and are the 11 bytes that are high for the 3,341 keepers and near 1 for outfielders. Feet are bytes -0x111 (left) and -0x110 (right), x5, checked against the five screenshots. Positions and attributes are one byte array at person-0x138 indexed by the game's attribute number (0-14 positions, stored 1-20; the rest attributes, stored 1-100). The hidden attributes come from the game's own getter: Dirtiness is attribute 0x38 (-0x100), Consistency 0x3B (-0xFD), Important Matches 0x3E (-0xFA), Injury Proneness 0x3F (-0xF9), Versatility 0x40 (-0xF8). Personality is the 8 bytes at person+0x70, unscaled 1-20: Adaptability, Ambition, Loyalty, Pressure, Professionalism, Sportsmanship, Temperament, Controversy (order read from the person getters). Staff CA/PA: i16 at person-0x26/-0x24 (plausible for all 19,681 staff). Staff Adaptability is the same person+0x70 byte as the players' (checked against four Real Madrid staff screens, which also supports the personality order). Staff attributes sit in db::NON_PLAYING_DATA (person-0xF0 to -0xBD) and are labelled from the staff set-field handlers: tendencies stored 1-20 and abilities stored 1-100. The staff job is the byte at person-0x22; its stored numbers are listed in the Role field's values. Club finances: db::CLUB_FINANCE at club+0x150. The transfer budget appears three times (+0x7C4, +0x7C8, +0x7D4, all £42,951,596 for Real Madrid); the editor writes +0x7C4, which is the copy the finance object's own set-field handler writes. +0x7CC is the guaranteed minimum for next season, +0x7D0 the % of transfer income given back, +0x814 the weekly wage bill. Balance is the i32 at finance+0xC (£100,461,188 for Real Madrid, matching the game). The wage budget is weekly at +0x808 (£6,284,565 = £27,233,115 a month); +0x834 holds the same figure, apparently next season's budget. The game shows wages per month (weekly × 52 / 12), and its lowercase 'm' means thousands. Fields added in the second pass come from the game's own per-record get/set property code (the handlers keyed by the 4-character field codes also listed in shared/data/editor.fmf), each checked against a few hundred live records; they are not yet confirmed on screen.
